justification: Changes when the daily DCP alarm baseline may be written and when an old baselined key alarms again.

pre_impl.existing_data: Force run 2 (dcp_monitor_chapter_results run_id=2): 563 rows, 547 active chapters, 539 overlap; 81 of 547 active not content-checked (8 with no row).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Run 2 was reported as 488/563 checked; measured on active chapters it is 466/547, so 14.8% unchecked, not 13.3%.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Extends the existing shrink-only baseline file with since and why per key; no new table.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a run over 10% unchecked can be baselined, a key loses its first date or reason, or a key baselined over 30 days stays quiet
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 13 hand mutants: 12 killed; the 13th removed a redundant no-rows check, which was then deleted (no rows already means every chapter unchecked).

functions.name: unchecked_share
functions.input: active chapters and the latest full run's result rows
functions.output: count of active chapters not content-checked, and the active count
functions.if_none: no rows means every active chapter is unchecked

functions.name: baselined_ages
functions.input: first-baselined date per key, today's red keys, today
functions.output: key and days baselined for keys still red, oldest first
functions.if_none: a missing or bad date counts as over the 30-day limit

functions.name: main
functions.input: command-line flags, a database connection, today
functions.output: exit 0 clean, 1 new or expired red or refused update, 2 could not look
functions.if_none: no DATABASE_URL or missing table exits 2

functions.name: message
functions.output: Telegram text now including EXPIRED lines
functions.if_none: None when every check is green

break_it.scenario: Baseline written from a half-broken run like run 2 (rate limits)
break_it.what_happens: silent: 81 unchecked chapters frozen as normal

break_it.scenario: A broken chapter is baselined and never fixed
break_it.what_happens: silent for ever: the baseline hides it
break_it.how: after 30 days it prints EXPIRED, exits 1 and goes to Telegram

break_it.scenario: Someone re-raises the baseline to silence expired keys
break_it.how: a key keeps its first date on every update

post_merge.manual_verify: After run 3: python scripts/verifyops_coverage.py --update --allow-raise 'force run 3 <date>' refuses if over 10% unchecked, else writes the baseline with since and why for every key.
